• Deep Work — cognitively demanding work that creates real progress
• Shallow Work — reactive tasks like emails, admin, and quick responses
Over time, you’ll clearly see where your meaningful work happens.

3. Reflect and improve
Focus is a skill that improves with awareness. Weekly insights help you understand:
• how many deep hours you created
• where distractions appeared
• how consistent your focus habits are
Small adjustments lead to better focus.

Key Features

Set a clear duration for intentional work with flexible time blocks and optional reminders to help you begin on time.

Start tasks instantly with voice commands, Home Screen widgets, and Lock Screen quick actions.

Identify patterns, distractions, deep hours, and improvement opportunities over time.

results.description:
Deep Task helps you do focused, deliberate work instead of drowning in an endless to-do list. Most productivity apps just give you more places to pile up tasks. Deep Task does the opposite: it pushes you to pick one clear goal, break it into small steps, set a timer, and actually get into the zone. Focus isn't something you're born with. It's a skill you build, one session at a time.

BREAK BIG GOALS DOWN
Big projects feel overwhelming because they're vague. Deep Task fixes that. Name the one outcome you're working toward ("finish the quarterly report," "study chapter 4," "ship the landing page"), then split it into concrete, bite-sized subtasks. A clear goal gives every session direction, and a short checklist turns an intimidating project into a series of small wins you can actually finish.

WORK IN FOCUSED SPRINTS
Every task gets a time box and a built-in countdown timer with a clean visual progress ring. You see both elapsed and remaining time at a glance, so you always know where you stand in the session. Need to step away? Pause and resume without losing a second. Your progress is saved automatically, even if you close the app. Gentle prompts discourage mid-session breaks and keep you in the deep-work zone until the timer is done, then celebrate when you cross the finish line.

CHECK IT OFF
Deep Task is about finishing real work, not just logging hours. Complete your subtasks within the time box and check them off one by one. When the last box is ticked, the task is done, celebrated, and archived. No busywork, no lingering clutter. If you finish early, the app encourages you to use the remaining time to polish and improve rather than rushing off.

PLAN YOUR DAY
Lay out your day on a clean, vertical timeline in the Schedule tab. Create deep-work blocks and choose exactly how they repeat:

- Everyday blocks for your daily routine
- Weekly recurring blocks for specific weekdays
- One-off blocks for special days and events

Set start and end times in simple 15-minute increments, and automatic overlap protection keeps your schedule conflict-free. Attach tasks directly to any block, then open it to see its time range and everything you've planned to get done.

SEE YOUR WHOLE WEEK
Tap into Week at a Glance to view all seven days at once, complete with block and task counts for each day. Jump straight to any day to plan ahead so you're always one step in front of your week instead of scrambling to catch up.

BUILD UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM
Consistency is the real productivity superpower, and Deep Task makes it visible. The Momentum calendar highlights every day you completed deep work, turning your effort into a streak you won't want to break. The Completed tab keeps a tidy history of finished tasks, organized by day with clear "Today" and "Yesterday" labels, plus stat cards showing what you've completed today, this week, and all-time. Watch the numbers climb and let your own track record keep you going.

A HOME BASE THAT KEEPS YOU MOVING
Your home dashboard greets you by time of day and surfaces what matters most: your active tasks, your current focus streak, and how much you've completed this month. Add tasks and subtasks on the fly, swipe to clear what's done, and move through everything with smooth, distraction-free navigation.

WHO IT'S FOR
Deep Task is built for knowledge workers, students, writers, developers, consultants, and anyone who wants to trade scattered, reactive busywork for calm, focused progress. If vague to-do lists and constant context-switching leave you busy but not productive, this is your reset.

Stop juggling everything at once. Do one meaningful thing at a time and build the momentum to keep going.

WHY NERVOUS SYSTEM REGULATION IS THE ANSWER

Your attention is the most powerful engine you own. Orbital Focus turns every focus session into a rocket launch — pick a destination, strap in, and the only way to arrive is to stay on task.

The longer you focus, the higher you fly. A 15-minute warm-up is a suborbital hop. 25 minutes is one clean orbit of Earth. A focused hour parks you in geostationary orbit, 35,786 km up. Push past 90 minutes and you leave Earth orbit entirely. Every minute is real thrust.

HOW A MISSION WORKS
• Pick a destination — a 15-minute Suborbital Hop, 25-minute Low Earth Orbit, a 45-minute rendezvous with Station Aurora, a full hour in High Earth Orbit, or a 90-minute Deep Space run to lunar distance. Each is a fixed block of focus.
• Name your payload (the thing you're actually doing) and choose a crew role — Work, Study, Read, Create, Code, Write, Train, Plan, Chores, or Relax.
• Feel the countdown. A cinematic haptic launch ritual — ignition rumble, Max-Q, stage separation — marks the real milestones of your session.
• Fly a living 3D Earth. Watch your spacecraft climb its true trajectory over a hand-rendered planet with daylight, city lights, and every flight you've ever flown.
• Coast phases = built-in breaks. Long missions split into burn segments with short coasts between them — pomodoro, in orbital mechanics. Fully configurable, or fly one unbroken burn.

THE HANGAR
Every focused minute earns Δv. Spend it across a fleet of real rockets — from the workhorse Falcon 9 to the mighty Falcon Heavy — and upgrade engines, tanks, and avionics. Launch from seven real-world pads: Cape Canaveral, Vandenberg, Baikonur, Kourou, Tanegashima, Wenchang, and Starbase. Premium also unlocks an exotic collection of legendary sci-fi capital ships, for pilots who want to fly something out of a movie.

A LOYALTY PROGRAM FOR YOUR ATTENTION
Climb six ranks, Cadet to Mission Commander, by logging real focus time. Ranks unlock new destinations and craft. Your lifetime distance is measured in light-seconds — and it only ever goes up.

LAUNCH LOCKDOWN
Optional app blocking powered by Apple's Screen Time. While a mission is in flight, your chosen distracting apps are shielded. Leave early and you don't crash — re-entries and pad scrubs still bank partial credit. Orbital Focus never punishes you for being human.

THE CUPOLA
Look out the window. Stream real satellite imagery of the world passing beneath your spacecraft — a live view from orbit, in flight.

FOCUS MUSIC
Download ambient flight-deck soundscapes on demand and cache them for offline sessions. Deep Space pilots can also pick a station skin — five orbital outposts to fly past.

MISSION REPLAYS
Scrub through recreated historic launches — Sputnik 1, Vostok 1, Crew Dragon Demo-2, the Space Shuttle and more — and watch them fly out on the same living globe.

EVERYWHERE YOU LOOK
Live Activities on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. An Apple Watch companion that flies on your wrist. Home Screen and Control Center widgets. Share your mission to a TV or the big screen.

STREAKS, ACHIEVEMENTS, LOGBOOK
Daily launch streaks, 16 achievements, and a full flight logbook with charts of where your hours actually go.

ORBITAL FOCUS PREMIUM (optional)
The core app is free, forever. Premium adds the live Cupola view, Advanced Insights and your full Flight Log, exclusive craft and destinations, and alternate app icons. Subscribe monthly or yearly, or unlock it once for life. Your focus minutes always bank — free or Premium.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads in the app. We never sell your data. Every mission record lives on your device, and Screen Time data never leaves your phone.

Built for students, makers, writers, engineers, and anyone with ADHD-adjacent attention who needs the session to feel like it matters.

FocusMinny is a focus timer and planner for study, work, personal projects, and daily habits. It helps you turn “I should do this” into a real plan: choose one task, give it a time and a length, then start it.

No huge list. No gold stars for opening an app. Just one clear promise and an honest record of what happened.

MAKE ONE CLEAR PROMISE

What are you doing? When will you do it? How long will you give it?

• Start the coding task or design work you keep avoiding

• Read, practise, or build a daily routine
• Protect a block of deep work from a busy day

WHAT YOU GET FREE

PLAN WITH MINNY

GET HELP WHILE YOU WORK

SEE YOUR FULL RECORD
See how often you keep your promises, how much focused time you put in, when you work best, where you usually stop, and what you have actually finished. Your record includes your recent weeks, your best hours, your usual quit points, and your session history.

Use it to spot the simple things that make a difference: a time of day that works, a session that is too long, or the work you keep avoiding. Then make the next promise better.

Choose any session length. Repeat promises for habits, weekdays, or specific days. Pick seven extra sounds: rain, ocean, forest, café, fireplace, library, and instrumental.

Most focus apps count minutes. FocusMinny also asks whether you did the work you said you would do.

That is the point.

results.description:
Flip your phone face down. The timer starts. Lift it, and the timer stops.

Flip Focus is a deep work timer for people who are tired of promising themselves they'll concentrate. There is no honour system here and no button to press when you get distracted. The session is physically bound to your phone: face down on the desk, you are working. In your hand, you are not.

WHY THIS ONE HOLDS UP

Every other focus timer runs happily in your pocket while you scroll something else. This one cannot. Flip Focus reads your phone's motion sensors and only accumulates time while the phone is actually face down. You cannot quietly cheat a session, which is precisely why the hours in your history mean something.

START IN ONE MOVE
Choose a session and flip. That is the entire ritual. No setup to work through every time you sit down, no timer to remember to start, no excuse to open the phone "just to begin".

BLOCK EVERY DISTRACTING APP
While a session runs, Flip Focus uses Screen Time to put your distracting apps behind a lock screen. It works as an allowlist rather than a blocklist: everything is blocked except what you deliberately permit, so a newly installed app cannot slip through a gap you forgot to close.

AUTO-PAUSE KEEPS YOU HONEST
Pick the phone up mid-session and the timer pauses itself and tells you to put it back down. Your streak is not broken by the pause; it is broken by pretending the pause never happened. Flip Focus simply refuses to pretend.

QUITTING TAKES A MOMENT
Ending a session early is still possible, it just isn't two taps any more. You copy out a short passage that makes the case for staying, then hold a button for a few seconds. Neither step is hard, and the way out is always there when you genuinely need it. It simply stops being something you can do without thinking. Most urges to quit don't survive the minute it takes.

SESSIONS THAT MATCH REAL WORK
Start from ready-made blocks for deep work, quick focus, study and creative work, or build your own with the length, name and colour that suit how you actually work. Long, uninterrupted blocks for hard problems. Short ones for clearing the deck.

SEE WHERE THE TIME WENT
After every session, mark how it went. Your dashboard tracks total sessions, total focused time and your success rate, with your recent sessions and outcomes laid out plainly. Because the timer cannot be gamed, the trend line is the real one.

BUILT TO STAY OUT OF THE WAY
A Live Activity keeps the countdown on your Lock Screen so you can check the time remaining without unlocking anything. Haptics confirm the start and finish of a block. The app is quiet, quick and does not ask for your attention while you are trying to give it to something else.

WHO IT IS FOR

Engineers, writers, designers, founders, analysts, researchers, students — anyone whose output depends on long stretches of uninterrupted attention, and whose phone is the single largest threat to getting them.

If you have tried focus apps before and drifted away from them, the reason is usually the same: they asked you to be disciplined about the tool itself. Flip Focus asks for one physical action, once, at the start. The desk does the rest.

Flip the phone. Do the work.

results.description:
Focus better. Do more. One beautifully simple app.

Pomodoro Focus Timer combines a clean, minimal work timer with a built-in to-do list — so you can plan your tasks and stay focused without juggling separate apps. Built on the proven Pomodoro Technique, it helps you work and study with minimal distraction and maximum productivity, whether you're at the office, in class, or working from home.

No clutter. No noise. Just you and your next focus session.

HOW IT WORKS
  1. Add the tasks you want to work on
  2. Pin a task to keep it front and center
  3. Start the timer (the classic 25 minutes — or set your own)
  4. Take a 5-minute break when it rings (fully customizable)
  5. Mark your task complete and repeat
  
A TIMER THAT WORKS THE WAY YOU DO
  • Customizable focus sessions, short breaks, and long breaks
  • Auto-start your next break or session — stay in flow, hands-free
  • Long breaks after every few sessions, on your schedule
  • Pause, skip, or reset anytime
  • Keep-screen-on mode and optional completion sounds
  • A simple, minimal timer that gets out of your way

 BUILT-IN TO-DO LIST
  • Add, edit, reorder, and complete tasks in seconds
  • Pin your most important task to the timer screen
  • Swipe to complete — or check tasks off right from a widget
  • Your tasks, always in sync across your devices

FULL APPLE WATCH APP
  • Start, pause, stop, and skip the timer from your wrist
  • Add tasks and mark them complete — no iPhone needed
  • Watch face complications for timer, tasks, and your streak
  • Use your watch as a remote for the timer on your phone

WIDGETS & LIVE ACTIVITIES
  • Home Screen & Lock Screen widgets for timer, tasks, and stats
  • Live Activity + Dynamic Island — see your countdown and pinned task at a glance
  • Control Center timer toggle (iOS 18)
  • Tap to play, pause, skip, or complete a task right from a widget

STATS THAT KEEP YOU MOTIVATED
  • Track focus sessions for today and all-time
  • Current streak and best streak
  • GitHub-style activity heatmap
  • Scrubbable charts by day, week, month, and year
  • See your most-worked-on tasks and personalized insights

SIRI SHORTCUTS
  • "Hey Siri, start a focus timer" — go completely hands-free

SYNCS EVERYWHERE
  • Real-time iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch
  • Your tasks, settings, and stats follow you everywhere

MADE TO BLEND IN
  • Beautiful Dark Mode everywhere
  • 8 accent colors to match your style
  • Clean, distraction-free design


Whether you're studying for exams, powering through deep work, or just trying to beat procrastination, Pomodoro Focus Timer is the simple, minimal productivity companion that keeps you on track.

We know you're not "addicted." You just want more focus. We know life happens—sometimes you break your goals. That's normal. That's okay. Hazel is here to support, not judge. Take a break? No problem. Get back on track? We're here for it.

Hazel is built with a warm, earthy color palette and a cute hedgehog mascot because staying focused should feel good, not scary. Every animation is smooth. Every button is thoughtful. This isn't corporate—this is made with love.

results.description:

Most productivity apps count your time. deepr protects it.

PROTECT THE SESSION
Choose how long you need. deepr starts the clock and shields the apps that pull you away — automatically, for exactly as long as the session runs, then gets out of the way. No permanent lockouts, no rules to maintain. The block exists while you are working and ends when you do.

SEE THE HOURS ADD UP
Every completed session lights a star. Enough stars complete a constellation. Constellations forge celestial artifacts you keep. It is a record of attention that accumulates into something worth looking at — rather than another streak counter that resents you for missing a day.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY
Your sessions, journals, statistics, streaks and the apps you block never leave your phone. Only your sign-in and your subscription status reach a server, because an account and a payment cannot work otherwise. No advertising identifiers. No analytics SDK. No tracking. Nothing sold, to anyone, ever.

The app-blocking uses Apple's Screen Time framework, which by design never tells us which apps you chose. We could not see them if we wanted to.

DEEPR PRO
A free trial, then a subscription. Pro unlocks the full artifact collection, the complete analytics history and the coaching prompts.

- Monthly, or annual at a substantial saving
- Cancel any time from your Apple ID settings

A NOTE ON WILLPOWER
deepr's blocking is a commitment device, not a security system. It adds friction at the moment you would otherwise drift. It is not designed to be unbreakable, and it is not a parental control. It is there to help you keep a promise you already made to yourself.

results.description:
Make focused work easier to start, easier to protect, and easier to see. Lockodoro is a calm Pomodoro timer for studying, deep work, and everyday tasks, with focus coins that make your progress visible.

FOCUS ON ONE THING
Choose a focus tag, set your timer, and give one task your attention. Use Lockodoro as a study timer for exam preparation, a work timer for writing and coding, or a simple way to bring the Pomodoro technique into your day.

Set focus sessions from 5 to 180 minutes and alternate focused work with short and long breaks. Start small, find your rhythm, and make time for rest.

TURN FOCUS INTO LOCKCOINS
Every completed focus session earns a bronze, silver, or gold Lockcoin based on how long you focused. Complete a full Pomodoro cycle to earn an extra gold coin.

Watch your effort add up in a pile you can see and move. Tilt your iPhone to watch the coins tumble with realistic physics and haptic feedback. Your on-screen pile starts fresh with your first completed focus session each week.

KEEP YOUR TIMER CLOSE
Follow your session on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with Live Activities on supported devices. Session-end notifications help you put your phone down without losing track of time.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
• Choose your focus duration
• Pick short breaks of 5 or 10 minutes
• Pick long breaks of 15, 20, or 30 minutes
• Use built-in tags for Work, Study, Reading, Exercise, and Planning
• Adjust sound and vibration reminders
• Keep the screen awake while the timer runs

PROTECT YOUR FOCUS WITH LOCKODORO PRO
Optional in-app purchase required.

Use the app blocker to reduce distractions during focus sessions. With Screen Time permission, choose apps, categories, and websites to restrict. Blocking follows your active focus session and lifts when the session ends, so you can take your break without switching it off manually.

UNDERSTAND YOUR FOCUS WITH PRO
Turn your session history into a practical focus tracker:
• Browse your personal focus history and previous weeks
• See session time ranges, actual focus time, and daily totals
• Review completed sessions and sessions stopped after at least 5 minutes
• Add missed sessions manually, edit entries, or delete them

PRO also lets you customize short and long break durations, choose how many focus sessions come before a long break, and create unlimited custom focus tags. Give each custom tag its own color and preferred session duration.

BUILT FOR STUDY AND DEEP WORK
From reading and revision to planning and creative work, Lockodoro gives your time management a simple structure: one task, a clear finish line, and a moment to recharge.

Start with one session. Focus, rest, and repeat.

Your phone is your biggest distraction. DeepDive turns it into your
biggest focus tool.

DeepDive is a high-intensity focus app built for people who want to
do real deep work — not just track time. It locks your phone during
focus sessions so you have no choice but to get things done.

HOW IT WORKS:

1. Plan your day — Start with intention. Write what you’re grateful
   for, set your daily intention, and pick your Most Important Task.

2. Set up your session — Choose your session length (10, 15, 30 min,
   or custom), how many sessions you need, and break duration.

3. Lock in — DeepDive goes full-screen. Your phone is a focus tool
   now. A giant countdown timer keeps you on track.

4. Take structured breaks — After each session, a timed break kicks
   in automatically. Rest, then lock back in.

5. Reflect — Rate each session (Focused, Flow State, Distracted,
   Slow) and jot notes on what you accomplished.

BUILT-IN COMMITMENT DEVICE:
An emergency exit is always available — but using it marks your
session as failed. Deep work requires commitment.

PRIVACY-FIRST:
No account required. No cloud sync. Your data stays on your device.
